sentences.japanese: 襟に染みがついてますよ。
sentences.english: Your collar has a stain on it.

sentences.japanese: 彼女はそのメダルをピンで襟にとめた。
sentences.english: She fastened the medal on the lapel with a pin.

sentences.japanese: 酒に酔った男が私の襟をつかんで汚い言葉を吐いた。
sentences.english: The drunken man grasped my collar and swore at me.

sentences.japanese: 見知らぬ男が私の襟をつかんだ。
sentences.english: A strange man caught me by the collar.
